name: Generate and refine specific research questions and hypotheses
description: Users asked the AI to generate, refine, or identify specific research components such as hypotheses, research questions, problem statements, and topic ideas across various academic disciplines. The requests focused on articulating the theoretical basis and scope of individual study elements rather than drafting complete thesis documents, full proposals, or comprehensive methodological frameworks.
